review_note: At line 2424, the source requires a pseudo-coherent closed immersion, bounded-below QCoh K and QCoh M with local Tor amplitude [a,∞). It asserts tensor/exact-support-Hom interchange on Z. The draft retains all three technical conditions, Li^*M on Z and the isomorphism direction.
statement:
Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of schemes with ideal sheaf $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$. Write $R\mathcal Hom_Z(\mathcal O_Z,K)\in D(\mathcal O_Z)$ for the *exact-support right adjoint* to $Ri_*:D(\mathcal O_Z)\to D(\mathcal O_X)$, characterized by $Ri_*R\mathcal Hom_Z(\mathcal O_Z,K)\simeq R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(i_*\mathcal O_Z,K)$; affine locally for $X=\operatorname{Spec}A,Z=\operatorname{Spec}B$ it corresponds to $R\operatorname{Hom}_A(B,-)$ with its natural $B$-module structure. Assume $i:Z\to X$ is a pseudo-coherent closed immersion, $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}^+(\mathcal O_X)$, and $M\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ has locally Tor-amplitude in $[a,\infty)$ for some integer $a$ (i.e. its derived tensor with a module has no cohomology below the indicated bound, locally). Then the canonical map induced by the counit of $(Ri_*,R\mathcal Hom_Z(\mathcal O_Z,-))$
\[
R\mathcal Hom_Z(\mathcal O_Z,K)\otimes_{\mathcal O_Z}^{\mathbf L}Li^*M
\xrightarrow{\sim}
R\mathcal Hom_Z(\mathcal O_Z,K\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}^{\mathbf L}M)
\]
is an isomorphism in $D(\mathcal O_Z)$.
hypotheses: Pseudo-coherent closed immersion; K bounded below D_QCoh; M bounded-below Tor-amplitude.
conclusions: Tensor by M commutes with derived exact-support Hom under these boundedness assumptions.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-sheaf-with-exact-support-tensor}
Let $i : Z \to X$ be a pseudo-coherent closed immersion of schemes.
Let $M \in D_\QCoh(\mathcal{O}_X)$ locally have tor-amplitude in $[a, \infty)$.
Let $K \in D_\QCoh^+(\mathcal{O}_X)$. Then there is a canonical isomorphism
$$
R\SheafHom(\mathcal{O}_Z, K) \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_Z}^\mathbf{L} Li^*M =
R\SheafHom(\mathcal{O}_Z, K \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_X}^\mathbf{L} M)
$$
in $D(\mathcal{O}_Z)$.
